description: This file defines the 'attributesRecord' class and related functions for managing admission attributes in Kubernetes, including annotations, user info, and reinvocation context.

classes.name: attributesRecord
classes.description: Represents admission request attributes, including resource info, user info, annotations, and reinvocation context.

classes.name: annotation
classes.description: Represents an annotation with audit level and value.

classes.name: reinvocationContext
classes.description: Holds context information for potential re-invocation of admission plugins.

methods.name: IsDryRun
methods.description: Indicates if the operation is a dry run.

methods.name: getAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves annotations up to a specified audit level.

methods.name: AddAnnotation
methods.description: Adds an annotation with default Metadata audit level.

methods.name: AddAnnotationWithLevel
methods.description: Adds an annotation with a specified audit level.

methods.name: IsReinvoke
methods.description: Checks if the context is a reinvocation.

methods.name: SetIsReinvoke
methods.description: Marks the context as a reinvocation.

methods.name: ShouldReinvoke
methods.description: Checks if a reinvocation is requested.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the reinvocation context.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the reinvocation context.
